"Yes, that is us."
Open configured demo inbox.

call_steps.hr: Name Yes is prompt-only; then send_code. No backend confirmation flag.

Speak its digits.

call_steps.hr: Digits enter HR records / request; verify_code returns status only.
call_steps.decide: Normalize digits; compare keyed hash; check expiry/limits. Consume code and verify together.

call_steps.hear: LD90001: Dallas to Atlanta; pickup, cargo, $1,800. Does that work?
call_steps.hr: Extract equipment and state codes; choose find_loads; speak returned public fields.
call_steps.decide: Gate before TMS. Exclude held loads; pick up to 3 OPEN future loads. Price safely; recheck gate at write.

call_steps.hr: Choose negotiate with the exact ask. Quote only service-approved counter.
call_steps.decide: Fresh LOAD_GET + pricing. Decide in versioned call write; <=3 call-wide counters. Same last ask/load uses no round.

call_steps.title: Agree on the rate
call_steps.hear: LD90001 agreed at $1,900. Senior rep will confirm (mocked handoff).
call_steps.hr: Send acceptance to negotiate first. Only agreed permits the spoken mocked handoff.
call_steps.decide: Fresh terms again. Claim one agreement per call; booking row decides the load holder; settle claim before replying.
